lessons_used: Reordering steps, wait countdowns, tutorial screens, personality headlines, and specific hints (path duration, account sync, pet persistence) consistently won.
Flow bypasses yielded mixed results, while major redesigns, trait selector flows, photo guidance, benefits copy, path time headlines, and account recovery hints hurt performance.
Notifications, layout modifications, incentives, permission checks, and wait screen activity tips showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains overall, especially for major redesigns, trait selector flows, shortcut guide screens, and copy changes.
Predictions underestimated gains for pet control tutorial screens, wait countdowns, personality headlines, path duration hints, and account sync safety hints.

candidates.title: Desktop tray and summon controls tutorial screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated tutorial screen after home welcome showing how to summon, hide, and interact with the pet from the system tray.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet on their desktop.

new_pet_tray_guide.headline: How to Interact with Your Desktop Companion
new_pet_tray_guide.body: Your pet lives in your system tray! Click the tray icon anytime to wake, hide, or chat with your pet.

guard.reason: Adds a valid desktop tray tutorial screen after home_intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Tutorial screens and pet control guidance consistently win and were underestimated in previous tests.

candidates.title: Cloud pet auto-sync reassurance hint
candidates.change: Display a explicit hint on the sign-in screen informing users that existing pets and progress will be automatically restored upon login.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back into their accounts.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically restores your saved desktop pets and custom preferences.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful auto-sync reassurance hint to the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Account sync safety hints perform well and address strong support mail signal with minimal config cost.

candidates.title: Live generation progress and estimate timer
candidates.change: Enable live percentage progress bars and real-time generation estimation on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Users spend a median of 201s and mean of 2336s waiting on the home step, leading to uncertainty during generation.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Companion
waiting.hint: Your companion is being assembled locally. This will take just a couple of minutes.

guard.reason: Adds live generation progress and real-time wait estimation to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Wait countdowns and progress estimators consistently improve conversion on long wait steps.

candidates.title: Companion personality path preview screen
candidates.change: Introduce a path overview screen before path selection that illustrates how companion personalities differ.
candidates.why: Choose_path step takes a mean of 514s as users hesitate over path choices without understanding their differences.

new_path_overview.headline: Explore Desktop Companion Modes
new_path_overview.body: Choose between active playmate, relaxed desk buddy, or focused study companion before selecting your pet.

guard.reason: Adds a new path preview screen before path selection within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adding extra preview screens and trait selector flows tends to add friction and lower performance.

candidates.title: Pet creation style preference sub-flow
candidates.change: Embed a style preference selection sub-flow directly into the pet selection screen to tailor visual generation output.
candidates.why: Adoption suffers from a severe dropoff rate (69.3%) and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation looking wrong or failing.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Reorder sign-in after photo upload
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur after photo upload, allowing users to build momentum before signing in.
candidates.why: Adoption completion is low at 69.3%; moving sign-in later leverages user momentum from custom pet creation.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in step after photo upload while retaining all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Reordering steps consistently yields strong gains (+7.0% historical data) by building user momentum.

candidates.title: Stage layout redesign for home welcome screen
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a focused stage layout featuring direct pet interaction action buttons.
candidates.why: Finish step completion is 71.6% with a high mean time of 5815s, indicating lack of clear direction at the final step.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Companion path expectation copy update
candidates.change: Update the headline and body text on the path selection screen to set clear expectations about companion behavior.
candidates.why: Choose path step takes a mean of 514 seconds; clear behavioral descriptions help users make faster decisions.

choose_path.headline: Pick Your Companion's Daily Vibe
choose_path.body: Select whether you want a calm background companion or an energetic desk friend who interacts often.

guard.reason: Copy update removes the required path choice between adopting and making your own pet.

candidates.title: Pet attributes confirmation screen
candidates.change: Add an attribute confirmation screen before adoption certificate where users verify their pet's name and visual traits.
candidates.why: Adoption is the lowest conversion step at 69.3% and 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation errors.

new_pet_confirm.headline: Confirm Your Companion's Traits
new_pet_confirm.body: Review your pet's name, visual style, and default behaviors before final adoption.

guard.reason: Adds an attribute confirmation screen before adoption certificate within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adding an extra confirmation screen at the adoption step increases drop-off despite high step impact.

candidates.title: Background pet generation status hint
candidates.change: Add a helpful reassurance hint on the waiting screen explaining that pet creation continues smoothly in the background.
candidates.why: Users spend a mean of 2336s on the home step, causing concern that the application has frozen or stalled.

waiting.hint: Pet creation continues in the background. Feel free to minimize this window while we finish up.

guard.reason: Adds a background status hint to the waiting screen while preserving its core function.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint on home wait step provides minor reassurance, though wait activity hints show moderate impact.

picked: Live generation progress and estimate timer

decisions.title: Live generation progress and estimate timer

shipped: Live generation progress and estimate timer
lessons_next: Reordering sign-in after pet/companion selection, wait time countdowns, pet control tutorial screens, personality headlines, and specific hints (path duration, account sync, pet persistence) consistently won.
Major redesigns, trait selector flows, photo guidance, benefits story copy, path time headlines, account recovery hints, and moving sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Notifications, layout modifications, incentives, permission checks, and wait screen activity tips showed no clear effect.
Flow bypasses yielded mixed results, winning in round 1 but hurting performance in round 3.
Predictions overestimated gains for major redesigns, trait selector flows, late sign-in reordering, and copy changes.
Predictions underestimated gains for pet control tutorial screens, wait countdowns, personality headlines, path duration hints, and account safety/persistence hints.
